title: What a consultation actually covers
summary: A walk-through of the questions we ask before any treatment is discussed.
body:
A first consultation covers medical history, skin and structural assessment, and a conversation about what result would feel meaningful to you.

Only once all three are understood does a plan get discussed, never before.

We also ask about previous treatments elsewhere, since past results and reactions are often the most reliable guide to what will and won’t suit you going forward.
